title: Half-Life: Alyx
japaneseTitle: ハーフライフ：アリックス
shortDescription: Valve's triumphant return to the Half-Life universe, widely hailed as the definitive masterpiece and killer app of virtual reality gaming.
historicalSignificance: Set the uncontested gold standard for AAA virtual reality gaming with its revolutionary 'Gravity Gloves' physics interaction, tactile weapon reloads, and chilling survival horror atmosphere, earning universal acclaim (93 Metacritic).

editorialContent.overview: Set five years before Gordon Freeman's awakening in Half-Life 2, 19-year-old resistance fighter Alyx Vance and her father Eli battle the Combine occupying City 17, attempting to steal a Combine superweapon locked inside a floating Citadel vault.
editorialContent.gameplay: Revolutionized VR interactions with the 'Russell' gravity gloves, allowing players to flick their wrists to telekinetically yank ammo clips, resin, and objects through mid-air into their physical hands, alongside physical manual weapon reloading and terrifying Jeff stealth puzzles.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Showcased the flagship capabilities of the Source 2 engine: photorealistic photogrammetry, real-time liquid physics inside glass bottles, and flawless hand-tracking interaction.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Proved that full-length narrative VR masterworks could achieve the legendary critical stature of the greatest traditional PC games.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on SteamVR with full community Steam Workshop level editing tools.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 2 million copies sold (historic milestone for PC VR hardware)
awards: The Game Awards Best VR/AR Game 2020

technicalSpecs.soundChip: True binaural 3D spatial acoustic audio by Mike Morasky
